fusions.name: Up the Arm
fusions.desc: You scramble up to 5 tiles onto the target and pound it for 13 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pilfered Pitch
fusions.desc: Throws 3 pilfered objects at once in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 3 damage. Each has 25% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Borrowed Brawn
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed by 15% for the first 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Stronger Than It Looks

riders.text: and blows find you less often
and your own blows come faster

fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver you have 5% more dodge chance, and from gold you attack 8% faster.
